title: onprem-airgap: offline bundle vendor updates for rke2 + ubuntu-22.04 TUF metadata and upgrade/rollback tooling
author: Elena Markov
description:
Summary: Update the on-prem/air-gapped offline bundle generator to vendor RKE2 runtime artifacts for Ubuntu 22.04 and Flatcar, roll TUF metadata into the bundle, bump the private-installer Helm chart, update Terraform module references, and add an idempotent upgrade/rollback helper to reduce operator blast radius during manual rollouts.

Motivation: Customers running private deployments on RKE2 (Rancher) have reported drift when using older vendoring that lacks Ubuntu 22.04 artifacts and up-to-date TUF metadata. This caused install/upgrade failures in air-gapped environments. The change vendors runtime images, systemd units, and kubelet/rke2 manifests into the offline bundle and adds signed TUF metadata so offline installers can verify package integrity without external network access. We also add safe upgrade/rollback tooling and Helm/terraform version bumps to make on-prem upgrades more deterministic.

What changed (high level):
- offline-bundle generator: add support for collecting RKE2 artifacts (rke2 binaries, rke2-server.service, cri configs) for Ubuntu 22.04 and Flatcar variants.
- vendoring: include updated containerd/runc/container images used by RKE2; add SHA256 manifests and TUF-signed metadata files under /tuf/ in the bundle.
- helm chart: bump redwood-private-installer chart v1.4.2 -> v1.5.0, add values to opt-in to rke2-specific hooks and extraVolumes for offline registries.
- terraform: update module reference to modules/compute/ubuntu-22-04 (pinning to v2.3.1) and add rke2 userdata template variants.
- tooling: add scripts/upgrade.sh and scripts/rollback.sh (idempotent, uses preflight checks and can perform dry-run).
- docs: update docs/onprem/airgap.md with vendor matrix and upgrade guidance.

Checklist:
- [x] Vendored RKE2 artifacts for Ubuntu 22.04 and Flatcar
- [x] Generated and included TUF metadata for offline verification
- [x] Helm chart bump and values documented
- [x] Terraform module references updated and tested in CI (unit/local plan)
- [x] Added upgrade/rollback helper scripts and smoke tests
- [x] Added integration smoke test that runs offline install in a local rke2 VM (CI job gated, runs in staging runners)

Testing:
- Local smoke runs: created an offline bundle (size ~1.8GB) and completed an air-gapped install in an LXC VM running Ubuntu 22.04.
- CI: offline-bundle generation job and helm/terraform linters passed after initial fixes. One CI job (integration/install-staging) failed on first run due to a missing systemd drop-in; fixed in second commit and then all checks passed.

Backward compatibility: The offline bundle generator keeps the existing bundle layout; new RKE2/Ubuntu artifacts are additive. Helm chart bump is non-breaking; values default to previous behavior.

Notes for reviewers: focus on the TUF metadata generation (scripts/tuf/generate_metadata.sh), the idempotency guarantees in scripts/upgrade.sh, and terraform module pinning. The TUF metadata is generated using our internal tuf-gen wrapper (scripts/tuf/README includes commands used).

Merge: squash and merge after approvals and green CI.
commits: Add RKE2 artifact collector and packaging logic (offline-bundle/generator)
Vendor updated container images and runc/containerd binaries for rke2
Generate TUF metadata and include signed snapshots/timestamp in bundle
Bump redwood-private-installer Helm chart to v1.5.0 and add rke2 values
Terraform: pin ubuntu-22.04 module v2.3.1 and add rke2 userdata templates
Add scripts/upgrade.sh and scripts/rollback.sh with dry-run and preflight checks
Fix systemd drop-in path for rke2.service (address CI failure)
Docs: update airgap.md with supported distro/variant matrix and upgrade notes
review_comments: Samir Patel: Please confirm TUF key rotation story - how do operators rotate keys for an existing offline bundle? (answered inline)
Li Wei: Can you make the upgrade script safer by defaulting to --dry-run? Minor nit on logging format; otherwise looks good.
Aisha Gomez: Verified the Helm values matrix for rke2; suggested adding example values for private registry configs.
Elena Markov (author): Responded - added --dry-run default and documented key rotation steps in scripts/tuf/README. Added example values to charts/examples/rke2-values.yaml.
release_notes: Adds RKE2 Ubuntu 22.04 and Flatcar artifacts to offline bundles, includes TUF-signed metadata, bumps private-installer Helm chart to v1.5.0, pins terraform ubuntu module for reproducible builds, and provides idempotent upgrade/rollback helper scripts for safer on-prem rollouts.
